Proposals.Development: Ethan returns to his apartment and resumes his ordinary routine, including cooking and preparing for bed, while explicitly acknowledging his fear of the incident but remaining unaware that his proximity caused the super's power loss. He dismisses the event as an unexplained anomaly or external device, maintaining his perspective as an ordinary civilian without recognizing his role.
Proposals.Evidence: He didn't know why the man's skills had failed. He'd heard claims about devices and drugs that could do things to supers, usually from people trying to sell something or attract an audience. Perhaps one of those claims had finally turned out to be true. Perhaps the explanation was something he hadn't heard of. He could produce possibilities all night and still know exactly as much as he did now.
Proposals.ProposedCurrentPhase: Ethan has returned to his ordinary life, unaware of his role in the suppression, and the mystery of the super's power loss remains unresolved, setting the stage for Aurora's investigation.
